assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

OpenCode 2.x rewinds a session in place through its API: POST /api/session/{id}/revert/stage {messageID, files} stages a boundary at a message and POST …/revert/commit applies it (2.1.4 openapi.json). The driver's revert step stages at the latest user message (the second turn's) and commits, then a third turn runs from the rewound point — the V1 `/undo` shape. The daemon's side, read from code: nothing in the 2.x reader handles a revert (the session_v2.revert column is read nowhere); metrics re-fold every remaining session_message row on each pass (metrics_v2.go), and the watcher reports only rows written past its cursor, so a revert by itself emits no event and leaves state as it was (ready) until the next write. The third turn's rows then drive working → ready on the same id. So the user-observable arc holds: same session_id, ready through the rewind, a clean next turn.

## Spec choices

- Turns 1 and 2 on one ses_… session; turn 2's ready holds through the rewind (at least 8s, with no transcript_removed); turn 3 runs on the SAME id.
caveats: What the store keeps after revert/commit (rows deleted vs hidden) is first measured by this recording's export; cumulative tokens/cost come from session_v2's columns and do not shrink on a revert (metrics_v2.go).

sources.note: 2.x reader: lists session_v2 rows with time_archived IS NULL; a session is admitted on its first session_message activity while a service is up (#2107); an archived or missing row emits EventRemoved (v2SessionGone)
queryV2SessionMetrics re-folds every session_message row in seq order; cumulative tokens/cost come from the session_v2 columns
2.x hook receiver: permission.asked holds waiting, session.execution.{succeeded,failed,interrupted} end the turn through HandleStopHook (#2108)

preconditions: One OpenCode 2.x `serve --service` running, with a model it can reach (this host: the sandbox service, local Kolibri-1 4-bit model (mlx_lm) at 127.0.0.1:8087); the rig never starts, stops or reconfigures it
The three XDG exports, coexist IRRLICHT_ONBOARD_HOME and a non-7837 bind address from replaydata/agents/opencode-v2/prerequisites.md; OPENCODE_DB unset
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
Two turns 6s apart (a next prompt inside 5s of a hook-ended ready reads as a bounce to the bounce check), revert the second (stage at its user message, commit), then a third turn on the same session
settings deny the shell tool in RUN_CWD/opencode.json (a backstop: the local model reached for it in a no-tool turn once)

script.text: Reply with exactly the word: one. Do not use any tools.
Reply with exactly the word: two. Do not use any tools.
Reply with exactly the word: three. Do not use any tools.

verify: two turns, then the revert leaves the session ready with no removal
turn 3 runs working → ready on the SAME ses_… id
